text:
alyssa: Quick review request — new mock for the model catalog compare. Two options: sticky compact summary row when multiple models selected vs single 'Filters' pill that opens a flyout. Which wins?

seon (Design): Summary row feels more discoverable for comparisons. Suggest collapsed-by-default on mobile.

mike_s (Eng): Sticky is fine but needs to sit outside the virtualized list. Can prototype.

jamie (Product): Badge copy: keep it short. 'P50', 'Cost / 1k', 'Err %'.

ravi (Eng-ML): Add a tiny 'KV hit' stat if we can. Helps choose variants.

luz (A11y): Accessibility notes: ensure summary gets focus when it appears and is announced. Filters button must have aria-expanded and the flyout role=dialog. Icons need accessible names.

seon (Design): Mock update uploaded: used icon+label badges (color + shape). Also added a per-row lock and a bulk 'Lock versions' toolbar action.

mike_s (Eng): I'll implement a micro-prototype. ETA: end of week. Need copy + A11y sign-off before I ship.

jamie (Product): I can sign off after copy tweaks and aria attributes are applied.

deploy-bot: Accessibility scan: low contrast warning on tooltip text (small size). Recommend contrast >=4.5:1.

alyssa: Great — I'll update the mock and post final assets. If no objections by Monday, let's move to implementation. :thumbsup:
